description: Domain-general Realization V0 bootstrap/regression cases. Each case names a real plan source (an accepted Action V0 design case or a live-shadow message), an authored authorized content inventory, one scripted candidate, and typed adversarial mutations. Not learning data and not evidence of human-like conversation quality.

required_coverage.4: factual question with no memory/tool content -> knowledge-gap disclosure
required_coverage.5: factual question with an authorized semantic-memory proposition
required_coverage.7: no episodic record -> 'no memory of', not 'never happened'
required_coverage.11: advice with a grounded option and basis
required_coverage.12: commitment blocked by unavailable application safety
required_coverage.13: tool result available versus tool result missing
required_coverage.16: playful framing that does not turn fiction into fact
required_coverage.19: non-nutrition topics across personal, practical, social, and factual turns
